story.name: us
story.text: For the first decade or so of this century, more Phase 1 clinical trials per million residents were run in the US than Australia.

story.name: australia
story.text: But beginning in 2014, Australia took the lead and never looked back, driven largely by the speed with which these trials are run there.

story.name: raw
story.text: When we swap the y-scale to look at absolute numbers of Phase 1 trials, the US is still ahead by far, but growth has leveled off over the past decade, whereas Australian trials have more than doubled in that time frame.

story.name: zoom
story.text: However, that’s not the end of the story. If we zoom in on Australia’s clinical trials…

story.name: stack
story.text: …and break them down by sponsorship country, the largest share belongs to the US, followed by Australia, then China, then other countries.
